gmcm.stack_interval.tooltip: The interval between stacking items (in ticks, normally ~60 ticks/s). Defaults to 60 ticks.
gmcm.max_slot.tooltip: The maximum number of items with same name and quality to stack in a machine. Set to 0 to disable stacking. Recommended to set to 1 for a more balanced gameplay, but you can set it higher if you want machines to be more efficient.
gmcm.tell_qi.tooltip: Mr. Qi is curious about your automation setup!
qimail: I see you've been automating your farm. Smart choice — though a shortcut if I'm honest.^I've sent a Hopper to your farm. Use them wisely, kid.^  Your friend, Mr. Qi
qimail.name: Qi's Gift For Automate
